column3: MT 6:1. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV spells גֵּרְשֹׁם as “Gershon.”
MT 6:2. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV spells “Gershom” as “Gershon.”
MT 6:5. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV spells “Gershom” as “Gershon.”
MT 6:13. NKJV includes the name “Joel” as Samuel’s firstborn, which is not in the Hebrew of this verse (compare 1 Samuel 8:2).
